The reference image for Purple_Seed_Stain is a perfect match — particularly the bottom-right panel shows an open pod with a seed displaying a distinct purple blotch, which is nearly identical to the test image.

**Key visual evidence:**
- Open soybean pod with 3 seeds
- One seed has a prominent purple/violet stain/blotch
- Other seeds appear normal yellow
- Some white material (fungal growth of *Cercospora kikuchii*) visible inside pod
- Pod walls show browning

This is a textbook presentation of Purple Seed Stain — the purple discoloration on the seed coat caused by *Cercospora kikuchii*, which is the same fungus responsible for Cercospora leaf blight.
